name: workout-api

dependencies.description: Stores the Athlete's exercises, routines, sessions, sets, and unit preference.
dependencies.name: workout-db

dependencies.description: Validates the bearer token the gateway forwards and resolves the caller's identity for scoping every record to that Athlete.
dependencies.name: workout-auth

description: Ballerina REST API owning all workout-tracking data: custom and built-in exercises, reusable routines, logged sessions and their sets, computed per-exercise progress trends and personal records, and the Athlete's unit preference. Every record is scoped to the signed-in caller. Does not render UI and issues no tokens itself — the gateway/IDP handle sign-in.
